messages:
Ally (marketing): Hey @eng-runtime — prepping the launch blog + webinar. Need a small, auditable bench bundle we can link: fp16 + int8, gen + embed latencies, cold vs warmed, and a 1-paragraph runbook. Can you deliver by Friday EOD?

Vik (eng-runtime): We can deliver. Two quick questions: 1) tokens distribution (short vs long)? 2) required percentiles?

Ally (marketing): Mostly short (8-64) with 10% long>1024. Please include p50/p90/p95 and a coldstart heatmap. For embeds p50 and p90 only.

bench-bot: ingest queued job#6001 -> reading payloads from drive:/marketing/launch-bench/v2_payloads.jsonl

Sam (eng-runtime-lead): Governance note — marketing must not publish selective samples. We require a 12% random holdout and the RNG seed recorded in manifest.txt. Also include raw per-request CSVs for SRE validation.

Ally (marketing): Understood — 12% holdout added and flagged in manifest.

Vik (eng-runtime): Running on staging dedicated cluster. Variants: fp16 baseline, int8-fast. Warm runs use 6 synthetic warmups; cold = strict. We'll test batch sizes [1] for slide numbers and add a batch=2 appendix. Deliverables: artifacts.zip (runs/*.csv, summary.csv, manifest.txt with seed, runbook.md, traces.tar.gz). ETA: Friday 17:00 PST.

Ally (marketing): Can the summary label pass/fail vs these demo targets: median_gen <= 260ms for <=64 tokens; embed p50 <= 30ms? Mark FAIL if either threshold is missed.

Vik (eng-runtime): We'll include pass/fail column in summary and a short note if reruns occurred. If p95 variance >40% we'll rerun with longer warmup and keep both artifacts.

bench-bot: job#6001 -> ingest complete: 54 payloads, artifacts staged at /artifacts/6001

Vik (eng-runtime): Posting a small CSV excerpt from smoke: 

```
req,variant,warmup,total_ms,model_ms,tokens
0001,fp16,false,435,420,48
0002,int8,true,205,190,32
0003,fp16,false,1280,1260,1500
```

Sam (eng-runtime-lead): Please ensure README documents kernel/version used for int8 and exact bench command with flags (we need reproducibility).

Ally (marketing): Thanks — once uploaded, ping #marketing with the one-line checklist: artifacts present, manifest with seed, pass/fail summary, runbook included. We'll wait for the verified summary before copying any numbers into the blog. :thumbsup:
